Verified and closing **UI-017 / #126** after all three original criteria and source/results review.

- C1: exact Medium-before-Large detents and genuine Medium→Large→Medium drags keep native/current/target values consistent; the large-only skip-partial path also passes.
- C2: genuine interactive dismissal sets Hidden and detaches the native view while composition and the attached state manager remain live; dismissal callback is exactly once.
- C3: all actual PartiallyExpanded/Expanded/Hidden values save/restore without a stale native owner; the iPad application observes actual regular-width traits and positive native geometry bounded by its owned window.


Actual once-acquired native originals:

- [ios-iphone/41593638135](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/41593638135) at [`ac5e1c4e`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/commit/ac5e1c4eea203ff521c01438151dd2da61db9ca7): **7/7 genuine iOS library methods**, 1 fresh original XML, zero failures/errors/skips, Gradle exit0/1558.79s and **23 authenticated public XCTest inputs**.

- [ios-ipad/41593671454](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/41593671454) at [`ac5e1c4e`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/commit/ac5e1c4eea203ff521c01438151dd2da61db9ca7): **7/7 genuine iOS library methods**, 1 fresh original XML, zero failures/errors/skips, Gradle exit0/1601.25s and **23 authenticated public XCTest inputs**.


All1,270 actual own-Git before/after inputs, exact four focused compiler sources, full runner0/Worker termination plus six ordered lifecycle/thread phases, signed/post-runtime custody and both library-app/input-runner cleanup were reviewed independently. Green XML alone was not used for closure; accepted native/source populations were not replayed.

[Exact library-level source](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/ac5e1c4eea203ff521c01438151dd2da61db9ca7/calf-ui/src/iosTest/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/ui/internal/NativeModalXcuiBatchTest.kt).


Scope: controlled iOS26.5 simulators and public native input, not physical devices, comprehensive assistive/rotation/profiling, consumer/API–ABI/dependency/legal/security or release certification. Earlier failed originals remain failed, with the exact initial hosted cause unknown. The current 8 iPhone and 7 iPad appearance warnings are retained; no package, release or deployment publication. Closure precedes documentation updates.
